segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Good morning everyone, let's do a quick standup. Bob, you want to start?

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: Sure. Yesterday I finished the database migration script and deployed it to staging. It's looking solid.

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: Today I'll be writing unit tests for the migration and then picking up the auth module story.

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: I'm blocked on getting the Supabase service role key from DevOps. Dan, can you send that over by end of day?

segments.speaker: Dan Okonkwo
segments.text: Absolutely, I'll send the Supabase service role key to you by 5 PM today.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Great. Carol, your turn.

segments.speaker: Carol Davis
segments.text: Yesterday I completed the design mockups for the meeting room page. I shared them in Figma, please review when you can.

segments.speaker: Carol Davis
segments.text: Today I'm starting on the summary page design. I expect to have a first draft ready by EOD.

segments.speaker: Carol Davis
segments.text: No blockers on my end.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Perfect. I'll review your Figma mockups this afternoon, Carol, and leave comments.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Yesterday I had syncs with the client and stakeholders. They confirmed go-live is March 28th — that's our hard deadline, team.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Today I'm drafting the deployment checklist and then reaching out to Vercel support about our bandwidth limit on the Hobby plan.

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: Quick question — do we need to write end-to-end tests before the March 28th go-live, or is that a stretch goal?

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Good question. Let's make end-to-end tests a hard requirement. Bob, can you own that along with Carol?

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: Yep, Carol and I will pair on end-to-end tests. We'll target having them done by March 25th.

segments.speaker: Carol Davis
segments.text: Agreed, March 25th works for me.

segments.speaker: Dan Okonkwo
segments.text: One more thing — I noticed the LiveKit token endpoint isn't rate-limited yet. We should add rate limiting before go-live.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Good catch Dan. Dan, please add rate limiting to the LiveKit token endpoint by March 22nd.

segments.speaker: Dan Okonkwo
segments.text: Will do, I'll have rate limiting on the token endpoint done by March 22nd.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Alright, anything else before we wrap? Any open questions?

segments.speaker: Bob Sharma
segments.text: Still not sure who handles load testing after the release. Should we loop in the DevOps team?

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Let's leave that as an open question for now and decide in Monday's planning session.

segments.speaker: Alice Chen
segments.text: Great standup everyone. Let's have a great day and hit that March 28th deadline!
